npm.reason: ReDoS in glob matching. Reached only through vite, vitest and typescript-eslint while building and testing; the released app does not contain it and production dependencies are not affected. No patched version exists (all versions up to 4.0.7).

cargo.reason: Unmaintained notice, not a vulnerability. The app does not use chrono directly; it comes with russh-sftp (SFTP) and suppaftp (FTP), which cannot drop it without a new release. No maintained version exists. Remove when both libraries move to jiff or time.
